- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Brad, please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars to see which of these slots (or others) work for them. Let me know their availability so we can find a time that works for all four partners.
